items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I got Joe Thomas came with me for awhile

ctx.x: Ed Hall was with me to the end of my run with the Cafe Society, and on trumpet, after Bill Coleman went to Europe, then I got Joe Thomas came with me for awhile -- do you remember Joe Thomas?

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: You did this for about a year with Teddy, didn't you, Baby? ... Oh, yeah. There was Teddy, of course. ... Benny Morton is on this side, there's Joe Thomas, trumpet player and Edmond me, Edward Hall, Sidney Catlett and Johnny Wilson.

ctx.x: Yes, we had a small group. We had six pieces I think. Very good playing, you know.
And then there's the next thing Teddy Wilson.
Yeah, with Teddy and a tremendous musician.
